    👤 People who sign quotes

    The selected person's name, title, phone and email appear in the sign-off of the Word and PDF quotation. Each device remembers the person last used, and a saved project remembers who prepared it. Use Export/Import to copy this list to a colleague's device.

    Send quotes for review to: Used by "📧 Send for review" — remembered on this device.

    📧 Send for review

    Emails the quotation PDF and the project file to the office. Web pages can't attach files to an email by themselves, so pick whichever route suits your device.
    Attachments:
    Downloads the files, then opens a new email addressed above — drag the downloaded files in as attachments. Works everywhere.
    Uses the device share sheet (Mail on iPad/iPhone/Mac, Outlook on Windows) with the files already attached — choose Mail and enter the address.
